When it comes to the common rights and needs of men and women, there is no place for discrimination or inequality. We must champion justice and fairness, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity is accessible. It’s about more than rights—it’s about respect. By fostering understanding and valuing diversity, we lay the foundation for a society where everyone can rise above limitations. This isn’t just a goal; it’s a commitment to humanity, a pledge to uplift and empower, ensuring that no one is left behind in our collective journey toward progress.

Imagine the breakthroughs: diseases eradicated, technologies revolutionized, connections deepened. The path ahead demands diligence, collaboration, and an unwavering belief in human ingenuity. Let’s seize this moment, for today’s curiosity is tomorrow’s legacy. Together, we can unlock the extraordinary.

The federal government will not micromanage how schools are run. We believe strongly -- we recognize the importance of local control in education, allowing communities to shape policies that best meet their needs. Teachers and parents must have the freedom to innovate without unnecessary interference. By fostering flexibility and encouraging creativity, we can ensure students receive diverse learning opportunities tailored to their unique potential. This approach empowers educators and supports a thriving, dynamic educational system. It’s about trust—trust in our communities, our educators, and our students. When we invest in local solutions, we see remarkable results: classrooms that inspire, curricula that resonate, and graduates ready to lead. Let’s continue to champion this vision, unlocking the promise of every child and building a brighter future for all.

Streamlined processes and transparent policies will reduce confusion, letting people focus on what matters most: their health. Together, we’re taking strides toward a system that works for everyone, safeguarding both well-being and dignity. This is progress we can all believe in.

Challenges that once seemed insurmountable have been met with determination and innovation. Communities have risen to the occasion, proving resilience in the face of adversity. Now, as we look ahead, it’s clear that our collective efforts can pave the way for lasting change. Let’s continue to harness this momentum, ensuring progress benefits all, leaving no one behind. Together, we can achieve what once seemed impossible.

Members, you and I will work together in the months ahead on other issues: productive dialogues, thoughtful solutions, and decisive actions. We must prioritize the needs of our communities, ensuring every voice is heard and every concern addressed. Progress demands collaboration, and by embracing diverse perspectives, we can craft policies that resonate with the people we serve. Challenges may arise, but with determination and unity, we’ll overcome them, paving the way for a brighter, more prosperous tomorrow. Let’s seize this moment with resolve.

For many Americans, these four months have brought sorrow and pain that will never completely fade. Yet, in the midst of struggle, we’ve also witnessed resilience—a spirit that refuses to be broken. Families have come together, communities have rallied, and hope has emerged even in the darkest hours. Now, more than ever, it’s crucial to stand united, offering support where it’s needed most. Through compassion and determination, we can heal, rebuild, and forge a path toward brighter days ahead.

In Africa, the disease clouds the future of entire nations and threatens to hold back progress for generations. But we’re not powerless in the face of this challenge. By harnessing innovation, strengthening healthcare systems, and fostering global partnerships, we can turn the tide. Investments in research and infrastructure will pave the way for breakthroughs. Communities must be empowered with education and resources to combat this crisis. Together, with resolve and compassion, we can lift the shadow of despair and rebuild hope, ensuring a brighter tomorrow for all.

When credible intelligence warrants, appropriate law enforcement and local officials are alerted. These warnings are, essential to safeguarding communities and preventing potential threats. Vigilance ensures safety, and coordination among agencies strengthens our defenses. By acting swiftly and decisively, we protect lives and uphold the rule of law. Transparency fosters trust, while discretion maintains effectiveness. This balance is crucial for national security and public confidence. United in purpose, we stand firm against adversity, committed to preserving peace and ensuring a secure future for all.

Twelve years ago, Iraq invaded Kuwait without provocation. And the regime's forces were poised to threaten the stability of the entire region. That aggression could not stand unchallenged. America, alongside our allies, acted decisively to restore peace and uphold justice. Today, we remember the courage of those who served and the resilience of the people who rebuild. The lessons of that conflict remind us that freedom and security are hard-won, yet always worth the effort. Together, we continue to strive for a world where liberty prevails over tyranny.

When America serves others in this way, we show the strength and generosity of our nation. It’s in these acts of selflessness that our character shines brightest. We demonstrate not just the power of our resolve but the depth of our compassion. Helping others isn’t just a duty—it’s a privilege. By extending a hand, we inspire hope and ignite change. Together, we prove that unity, not division, is our greatest asset. Let’s continue to lead by example, ensuring that our actions reflect the enduring values we hold dear.

America pursues medical advances in the name of life, and we will achieve the great promises of innovation with unwavering determination. Breakthroughs in medicine not only save lives but also inspire hope, renewing our collective spirit. By investing in cutting-edge research and fostering collaboration between experts, we can tackle the most pressing health challenges. This commitment to progress ensures that every American, regardless of background, can access the care they deserve. Together, we’ll transform the landscape of healthcare, turning today’s possibilities into tomorrow’s realities.

This is not just a threat to Iraq—it’s a threat to the world. We must stand firm, united in purpose, to counter their ambition with resolve. Freedom, security, and stability are not optional; they are essential. By working together, bolstered by shared values and strategic partnerships, we can thwart their plans and protect the innocent. This is a call to action, a reminder that vigilance and perseverance are the keys to preserving peace. Let us move forward with determination, knowing that the stakes are high, but the cause is just. The future of liberty depends on us.

That legacy lives on in our commitment to liberty and self-governance. It’s not just history; it’s a call to action. By upholding these values, we ensure freedom endures. Together, we honor the past while forging a future rooted in fairness, opportunity, and unwavering resolve. Democracy thrives when we protect it.

Our nation was built by those who sought opportunity and freedom, and it’s our duty to honor that legacy. By creating a system that’s fair, efficient, and compassionate, we can uphold justice while strengthening our economy. Let’s ensure that our policies recognize the dignity of every individual, fostering unity and progress. Together, we can craft a future where opportunity knows no borders.

Defeatism may have its partisan uses, but it is not justified by the facts. For a nation built on resilience and determination, surrender is never an option. History reminds us that challenges, no matter how daunting, are surmountable with unity and resolve. Let us not succumb to doubt, but rather, let us forge ahead with confidence. The truth is, progress demands courage and steadfastness. By focusing on solutions and embracing optimism, we can overcome any obstacle and achieve greatness. Together, we rise.

Taken together, these steps represent decisive action to ease the credit crunch that is now hindering economic growth and stifling innovation. By injecting liquidity into the market and restoring confidence in financial institutions, we ensure that businesses can access the capital they need to expand and create jobs. These measures aren’t just about stabilizing the present; they’re about laying the foundation for a more resilient and prosperous future. Confidence, once restored, fuels momentum, and momentum drives progress. It’s through these deliberate, strategic actions that we’ll rebuild trust and unlock the full potential of our economy. Together, we can overcome this challenge and emerge stronger, ready to seize the opportunities ahead.

In the case of Iraq, the Security Council did act, in the early 1990s. Under U.N. Resolution 687, the Council imposed stringent measures, demanding full disarmament of weapons of mass destruction. Compliance was essential to safeguard global peace. The world stood united, sending a clear message: aggression would not be tolerated. While challenges persisted, diplomacy prevailed, underscoring the power of collective action. Iraq’s path forward required transparency and cooperation, principles vital for restoring trust and stability in the region. Together, we demonstrated resolve, proving that shared commitment can overcome even the most daunting threats.

My opponent recently announced that he is the conservative -- the candidate of "conservative values," preaches traditional virtues, and upholds principles passed down through generations. But let me be clear: values aren’t just about the past; they’re about securing a future where every American can prosper. True conservatism isn’t rigid—it’s adaptable, forward-looking, and rooted in the realities of today. It’s not about preserving divisions; it’s about uniting communities, fostering opportunity, and ensuring progress for all. Together, we can honor our heritage while boldly embracing the promise of tomorrow.

This changed world can be a time of great opportunity for all Americans to earn a better living and secure a brighter future. By embracing innovation and fostering resilience, we can navigate challenges with confidence and purpose. Let us build a nation where hard work is rewarded, and dreams are within reach. Together, we can pave the way for prosperity, ensuring that no one is left behind. It’s a call to action—a shared commitment to progress and possibility. The path ahead is clear, and the time to act is now.

While the most visible military action is in Afghanistan, America is acting elsewhere. We now have intensified efforts in regions where extremism festers, working alongside allies to dismantle networks that threaten global stability. From intelligence sharing to strategic partnerships, every measure strengthens our collective resolve. We’re not just fighting battles; we’re building alliances. The mission extends beyond borders, safeguarding freedom and justice. It’s a commitment rooted in unity, vigilance, and the unwavering belief that peace is achievable when we stand together.

The United States respects the people of Afghanistan--after all, we are currently its largest source of humanitarian assistance. Our commitment to their future is steadfast, rooted in shared values of dignity and resilience. We’ve seen the strength of the Afghan spirit, and we’ll continue to support their journey toward stability and self-reliance. It’s not just about aid—it’s about partnership. Together, we can help forge a path where hope prevails, opportunities flourish, and peace becomes a lasting reality. This is our pledge, unwavering and true.

On September the 11th, enemies of freedom committed an act of war against our country. Americans have seen the horrors of terrorism, but they have also witnessed the courage and resolve that define our nation. In the face of adversity, we come together, united in purpose and strengthened by our shared values. We will hunt down those responsible, bring them to justice, and ensure such darkness never threatens our way of life again. Through resilience and determination, we reaffirm our commitment to liberty, standing firm as a beacon of hope for all who cherish freedom. Together, we will rebuild, recover, and emerge stronger than ever before.

Our nation, working with allies and friends, has also confronted the enemy abroad, with measures ranging from precision strikes to strategic diplomacy. These efforts have not only weakened hostile forces but also strengthened global partnerships. By standing united, we’ve demonstrated resolve in the face of adversity. The fight is far from over, but progress is evident—lives saved, freedoms protected, and stability restored. Now, more than ever, we must remain vigilant, adapting to new threats while upholding the values that define us. Together, we can ensure peace and security for generations to come.

To make our economy stronger and more productive, we must make health care more affordable, accessible, and reliable for every American. By reducing the financial burden on families and businesses, we can unlock new opportunities for growth and innovation. Affordable health care means a healthier workforce, fewer sick days, and increased productivity. It’s not just about cutting costs—it’s about investing in people. When we prioritize well-being, we build a foundation for sustained economic success. Together, we can create a system that works for everyone, ensuring prosperity and resilience for generations to come.

America confronted imperial communism in many different ways -- diplomatic, economic, and military. Yet moral clarity was our greatest weapon. It’s not enough to oppose an ideology; we must stand firmly on the principles of freedom and human dignity. These values define who we are as a nation and guide our actions on the global stage. By championing liberty, we not only resist tyranny but inspire hope in those who yearn for a brighter future. Together, we affirm that justice and opportunity are not privileges but universal rights.

And I will carry this: It is the police shield of a man named George Howard, who bravely served his community with unwavering dedication. Howard’s legacy lives on, urging us to protect, to lead, to unite. In his memory, we find inspiration—a call to uphold justice and compassion, to cherish the values that bind us together as one nation.

Good evening. Three days ago, in large numbers, Iraqis went to the polls to choose their leaders freely and without fear. This historic step marks a pivotal moment in their journey toward democracy, a journey that demands courage, resilience, and unwavering hope. It’s a testament to their determination to build a future defined by liberty, stability, and prosperity. Every vote cast signifies a voice heard, a choice honored, and a dream pursued. Together, they’ve shown the world that even in the face of adversity, the spirit of self-determination prevails. This is not just their victory; it’s a beacon of hope for all who seek freedom. Let us stand with them, reinforcing our commitment to a world where justice and opportunity are not privileges but universal rights. Their courage inspires us all.

Together, we can ensure that every individual, regardless of age, can live with security and purpose.

History shows that hesitation in the face of such threats only emboldens aggressors. Let us stand firm, upholding our principles and protecting our shared future. The world looks to us for leadership; we must rise to the occasion.

The terrorists do not merely object to American actions in Iraq and elsewhere, they object to the very ideals we stand for—freedom, democracy, and the inherent dignity of every human being. Their aim is not just to intimidate but to obliterate the principles that bind us together as a nation and as a global community. We must confront this threat with resolve, unity, and an unwavering commitment to our values. Compromise is not an option; the stakes are too high. Together, we will defend the liberties we cherish and ensure that justice prevails. Let our actions speak louder than their hatred, and let our resolve be a beacon of hope for all who seek peace. Victory is not just possible—it is inevitable.

In an ownership society, more people will own their health care plans, and have the confidence to make informed decisions about their well-being. This shift empowers individuals, giving them control over their own care while reducing dependency on fragmented systems. By promoting personal responsibility and expanding access to affordable options, we build a foundation where health isn’t just a privilege but a right. Families deserve stability, and this approach ensures that no one is left behind. Together, we can create a healthier nation, where every citizen has the tools and support to lead a fulfilling life.

While many of our citizens prosper, others doubt the promise, even the justice, of our nation. They question whether the system truly serves everyone equally, or if it merely perpetuates privilege for the few. These concerns are valid, and we must address them with honesty and resolve. By strengthening communities, expanding access to opportunity, and ensuring fairness in every corner of our society, we can restore faith in the promise of America. Together, we must prove that justice is not just an ideal but a lived reality for all. Let’s bridge divides, empower the marginalized, and reaffirm the principles that make our nation a beacon of hope and possibility. The work is hard, but the rewards are worth it—a stronger, more united country where every voice matters.

Our nation will continue to be steadfast and patient and persistent in the pursuit of peace, liberty, and prosperity for all. We understand that progress isn’t instant—it’s a journey, one that requires resilience and collective effort. Challenges will arise, but they will be met with resolve and ingenuity. Together, we’ll uphold the values that bind us, ensuring that every generation inherits a stronger, more united nation. The path ahead is clear, and we’ll walk it with determination and hope.

In this place, there's a custom for the funerals of jazz musicians. The funeral procession In this place, there's a custom for the funerals of jazz musicians. The funeral procession moves with a rhythm all its own, honoring the soul of the music and the life it celebrated. Mourners sway to the beat of a brass band, their footsteps echoing the melodies that once filled the air. It’s a farewell steeped in tradition, a final note played with reverence and joy. Through sorrow, the music lives on, uniting generations in a shared legacy of artistry and passion. This ritual isn’t just about loss; it’s a celebration of a life well-lived, a testament to the enduring power of jazz to inspire, heal, and connect. In every note, the spirit endures, carrying memories forward with grace and dignity.

By welcoming talent from abroad, we reinforce our values of opportunity and fairness. This initiative bridges gaps, builds mutual understanding, and ensures a workforce ready to meet the challenges of tomorrow. Together, we grow stronger, united in purpose and vision for a brighter future.

The United States has a long and proud record of leading the world toward advances in science, technology, and innovation. From the moon landing to breakthroughs in medicine, our nation has demonstrated what’s possible when vision meets determination. But leadership isn’t just about past achievements—it’s about forging ahead. Today, we stand at the forefront of new challenges, ready to pioneer solutions that shape a better tomorrow. By investing in research, embracing ingenuity, and fostering global partnerships, we ensure that America continues to light the way, inspiring progress and hope for generations to come. Together, let's push boundaries, dream boldly, and uphold the promise of a brighter, more prosperous future.

In January of 2006, seniors can get prescription drug coverage under Medicare. For a monthly premium as low as $20, they’ll gain access to life-saving medicines, ensuring their health isn’t compromised by cost. This initiative prioritizes affordability while safeguarding quality care. It’s a commitment to our elders, honoring their contributions by easing their burdens. By offering accessible options, we empower them to live fuller, healthier lives. This isn’t just policy—it’s progress, a testament to our shared responsibility to care for those who paved the way. Together, we can build a system where dignity and well-being are within everyone’s reach. Let’s seize this opportunity to make a lasting impact, ensuring no senior is left behind. The path forward is clear, and the time to act is now.

I know that the families of our military are praying that all those who serve return home safely, their hearts filled with pride and gratitude. Our brave men and women in uniform sacrifice so much for our freedom, and their loved ones stand strong beside them. It’s our duty to honor that courage, to support those who wait, and to ensure that no family faces hardship alone. Together, we can uphold the promise that service is met with steadfast care and unwavering respect. Let’s unite in gratitude and commitment, ensuring their sacrifices are never forgotten.

A hopeful society gives special attention to children who lack direction and love. Through the collective efforts of families, communities, and institutions, we can provide the guidance and support these young lives desperately need. By nurturing their talents and dreams, we instill a sense of purpose and belonging. Education, mentorship, and compassion are the cornerstones of this mission. Together, we can ensure that every child has the chance to rise, flourish, and contribute to a brighter, more compassionate world. Hope begins with action, and action begins with us.

The Egyptians and Jordanians and Saudis have helped in the wider war on terrorism. These alliances underscore the power of solidarity in confronting threats head-on. By standing together, we send a clear message: terror will not prevail. Progress demands persistence, and together, we’re building a safer, more resilient world.

The issue of research involving stem cells derived from human embryos is increasingly the subject of public debate. Ethical considerations must be weighed alongside scientific promise, as we navigate this complex terrain. Progress demands respect for life while pursuing breakthroughs that could alleviate suffering. Collaboration between ethicists, scientists, and policymakers is crucial to establish guidelines that balance innovation with integrity. By fostering dialogue and transparency, we can ensure advancements that honor both human dignity and the pursuit of knowledge.

Our goal is to get people out of the shelters by the middle of October. By then, we aim to ensure every family finds a safe, stable home, restoring dignity and hope. Through partnerships and streamlined resources, we'll cut through red tape, making transitions swift and seamless. Communities will rally, offering support and compassion. This isn’t just a deadline—it’s a promise to uplift lives, one household at a time. Together, we’ll turn uncertainty into opportunity, building a foundation where resilience thrives and futures flourish.

In the days just after September the 11th, I told the American people that this nation would emerge stronger and more united. I said that we would confront evil, defend freedom, and rebuild with unwavering resolve. Together, we faced the darkness with courage, and in the aftermath, we found strength in unity. Out of tragedy grew resilience, and from loss, a renewed commitment to our shared values. America stood tall, proving that even in our darkest hours, hope and determination light the way forward.

Good jobs depend on sound tax policy. Last year, some in this hall thought my tax plan was too ambitious. But look at the results—thriving businesses, more employment opportunities, and stronger communities. When we cut burdensome regulations and lower taxes, we unleash innovation and growth. It’s about leaving more in the pockets of hardworking Americans, so they can invest, spend, and build a brighter future. We’ve seen the proof. Now, let’s keep pushing forward, ensuring prosperity isn’t just a promise but a reality for all.

On this day, prescribed by law and marked by ceremony, we celebrate the durable wisdom of our founding principles. They call us to action, urging us to safeguard freedoms and uphold the rule of law. Let us honor this legacy by committing to unity, resilience, and progress. Together, we can ensure these values endure for generations, lighting the path toward a brighter, more just tomorrow.

The path forward demands courage, compromise, and a commitment to stability. By fostering trust and rejecting extremism, we can build a region where hope replaces fear, and prosperity prevails over chaos. Together, we can turn the tide.

Competition between great nations is inevitable, but armed conflict in our world is not. More than ever, we must pursue paths of diplomacy and mutual respect. Dialogue, not destruction, must define our interactions. By fostering understanding and collaboration, we can address shared challenges—climate change, economic inequality, global health. Strength lies not in dominance but in unity. History teaches us that peace is a product of effort, negotiation, and compromise. Let us choose progress over peril, striving together for a world where prosperity and harmony prevail. The stakes are high, but so is our resolve.

By embracing courage and determination, we can overcome adversity and build a brighter tomorrow. Let this day be a reminder that, together, we possess the strength to shape our destiny. Prosperity is a shield against despair, and by fostering global partnerships, we can fortify communities against turmoil. Innovation and investment are critical—they build resilience and create pathways for progress. Let us champion policies that inspire confidence, expand opportunity, and lift people from hardship. This isn’t just changing offices—it’s reshaping priorities to better serve the American people. We’re streamlining processes, cutting red tape, and ensuring every dollar spent advances our nation’s mission. Efficiency and accountability will be our watchwords. By empowering agencies to innovate and collaborate, we’ll deliver results that matter—safer communities, stronger infrastructure, and a government that works for everyone. This is about leadership, vision, and action. Let’s rise to the moment, united in purpose.

Let’s invest in research, cultivate partnerships, and champion policies that accelerate progress. Together, we can turn potential into action, ensuring a brighter, cleaner tomorrow for all.
